say:0:1621218501:1.text: Turns out the forest commotion started when small animals ate toxic, non-native fruit. The mysterious flutist, who claims to be from an animal protection association, seems to have known all along. There may be more to his visit than he lets on.
say:0:1621218501:1.source_cn: 林间的骚动源于小动物误食外来有毒果实，而那位神秘吹笛人...
